page.title: Intents
page.description: Let the agent act during the conversation: register a lead, deal or task in Bitrix24, or query your systems (order status, duplicate invoice, scheduling).
page.emptyDescription: Example: when the customer asks about an order, the agent asks for the number, queries your API and replies with the status and the delivery estimate.

executions.title: History: {name}
executions.description: Latest times the agent used this intent.
executions.empty: The agent has not used this intent yet.

pairs.name: Name
pairs.headerNote: Header values (such as API keys) are stored encrypted and are not shown again.

intent.title: Intent
intent.description: When the agent should use this intent.

info.title: Information
info.description: What the agent asks the customer before acting (optional).

action.title: Action
action.description: What happens with the collected information.

response.title: Response
response.description: How the agent replies to the customer after the action.

intent.name: Name
intent.nameHint: Short and unique within this agent. E.g. Register interest.
intent.whenToUseHint: This is what the agent reads to decide whether to use the intent. Describe the customer's situation, not the action. {count}/{max} characters.
intent.whenToUsePlaceholder: When the customer wants to talk to a salesperson or asks for a quote

fields.empty: No information: the agent acts without asking the customer anything.
fields.descriptionPlaceholder: Optional: how to ask the customer. E.g. which plan or product they want to know about

action.bitrixDescription: Lead, deal, task, comment or transfer to an agent.
action.webhookDescription: Queries or sends data to one of your systems.
action.runNote: They run right away, in this order, in your portal. Comment, deal and transfer use the conversation in progress.
action.autoParams: The agent builds the parameters on its own
action.autoBody: The agent builds the body on its own

response.byActions: By the result of the actions
response.byActionsDescription: The agent confirms what was done, e.g. "I registered your interest".
response.byApiDescription: The agent interprets the response and replies with the information.
response.byInstructionDescription: You write how the agent should reply.
response.instructionPlaceholder: Say thanks, say that a salesperson will continue the conversation and do not promise deadlines
response.summaryAsksBitrix: The agent asks for {fields} and then does in Bitrix24: {what}.
response.summaryAsksApi: The agent asks for {fields} and then calls {what}.
response.summaryNoAskBitrix: Without asking anything, the agent does in Bitrix24: {what}.
response.summaryNoAskApi: Without asking anything, the agent calls {what}.

errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Some fields are invalid. Review them and try again.
errors.INTENTION_MANAGED_BY_FUNCTION: This intent comes from the agent's function; change it in the function form
errors.INTENTION_NAME_RESERVED: This name is reserved for the customer's CRM lookup. Choose another name
errors.INTENTION_NAME_TAKEN: This agent already has an intent with this name
errors.AGENT_OUT_OF_SYNC: The agent was not found in GPTMaker; contact support
errors.INTENTION_NOT_SYNCED: The intent has not been located in GPTMaker yet. Try again in a moment
errors.INTENTION_BUSY: Another intent of this agent is being saved; try again in a moment
errors.GPTMAKER_TRAIN_FAILED: GPTMaker could not train the agent with this intent. Review the texts: each field description up to 255 characters and "when to use" up to 512
errors.GPTMAKER_REJECTED: GPTMaker rejected the intent. Review the data and try again
errors.GPTMAKER_UNAVAILABLE: Could not save the intent in GPTMaker right now. Try again in a moment
